title: `updateXP` can be omitted during liquidation
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Though the `liquidate` function invokes `dyad.burn` the `updateXP` can be omitted in case the liquidated note has no `KEROSENE_VAULT` or `depositAmount == 0`.
